I restyled `component.html` in place to the Harbor brand. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't checked how it looks.

- **Colors:**
  - The page and component background is Paper (#F4EFE6).
  - The card and the select fill are Card (#FBF8F2).
  - Primary text is Ink (#1E2B24).
  - Timestamps are Muted (#5E6B63).
  - The "Date range" label, the bold timestamp style, and the select focus ring use the Accent (#C2410C).
  - The select hover uses Accent tint (#F6DFD0).
  - The card border and row dividers use Sand (#E9E1D2).
- **Type:** Body text is now Instrument Sans. The page title is Fraunces 400 in sentence case. I removed the all-caps and the old display font. The 12px label spec was already correct.
- **Shape:** The card radius is 6px (it was 16px) and the select radius is 4px (it was 12px). No pills.
- **Kept as is:** Content, layout, sizes, spacing and the motion curve. The select was already 44px tall.

I picked two things myself, since DESIGN.md doesn't say. The select border is Muted, so the input stays clearly visible. The card border uses Sand for a quiet edge. If you'd rather have Accent line (#E8A989) on either, it's a one-line change.

The fonts are named in the CSS but there's no `@font-face` or font link. They'll only render if they're installed or loaded elsewhere. Otherwise they fall back to Georgia and Helvetica Neue.
